headline: Kazakhstan Plans 15 Oil and Gas Manufacturing Plants Worth $85M
summary: Kazakhstan is establishing 15 manufacturing facilities in partnership with domestic and international equipment manufacturers, investing $84.8 million to localize the production of oil and gas equipment.
why: Kazakhstan holds Central Asia's largest oil reserves, and its government has been pursuing localization requirements to expand domestic industrial supply chains.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Localizing oilfield machinery manufacturing creates industrial capacity and lowers dependence on imported hardware.
